title: Illinois Appliance Rebates 2026: ComEd Heat Pump Dryer, Induction and Washer Rebates
desc: Illinois appliance rebates in 2026: ComEd pays $200 for a heat pump dryer, $100 for an induction cooktop, $40 for a washer and $75 for a smart thermostat. Buy by December 31, 2026.
lead: In Illinois the appliance rebates come from ComEd for homes in Chicago and northern Illinois. ComEd pays $200 for a heat pump clothes dryer, $100 for an induction cooktop or range, $75 for a smart thermostat and smaller amounts for washers, dryers, dehumidifiers and air purifiers. You must buy by December 31, 2026. We could not confirm appliance rebates from other Illinois utilities. Here is the full list we read on October 6, 2026.
cards_intro: Amounts are from ComEd's appliance rebate page. Check ComEd for the newest list before you buy.

cards.title: Heat pump clothes dryer
cards.note: ENERGY STAR certified. Instant coupon, online or mail-in rebate.

cards.title: Induction cooktop or range
cards.note: Induction models do not need the ENERGY STAR label.

cards.title: All-in-one washer dryers
cards.note: $250 with an electric dryer, $350 with a heat pump dryer.

cards.title: Washer and electric dryer
cards.note: ENERGY STAR certified. One of each per account each program year.

cards.title: Smart thermostat
cards.note: One per account each program year.

cards.title: Dehumidifier and air purifier
cards.note: Up to two of each per account.

cards.title: Free products and appliances
cards.note: Income-eligible homes can get free products, and ComEd's Whole Home Electric offer pays for a stove and dryer. The gas-home money is allocated for 2026.

after_cards: ComEd lists weatherization products, such as caulk and weatherstripping, with in-store discounts up to $3. A heat pump water heater is listed on the same page at up to $750 and has its own guide.
sections: You must be a current ComEd residential delivery customer. The appliance must be new, so a used one or one from a reseller does not count. It must be ENERGY STAR certified, except induction cooktops and ranges. You must buy by December 31, 2026 and apply within 60 days of the purchase or by February 28, 2027, whichever comes first. The rebate cannot be more than the price of the appliance. You pay the tax. ComEd says a rebate cannot be combined with other ComEd efficiency offers.
Why a heat pump dryer is worth a look

A heat pump dryer uses a closed loop of air and uses much less energy than a standard electric dryer. ComEd's page says an ENERGY STAR model uses about 70 percent less energy than a conventional one. It is the biggest single appliance rebate besides the all-in-one units. ComEd's income-eligible page notes that most heat pump dryers are ventless, so they are easier to install than a standard dryer. Ask the seller whether your model needs a vent.

An induction cooktop heats the pan itself. ComEd says induction uses about 18 percent less energy than standard electric cooking. The rebate is $100, and it applies to select models. If you cook on gas now, switching to induction may also mean wiring changes, which the rebate does not cover. Ask an electrician before you buy.

Peoples Gas and Nicor Gas pay for gas furnaces, boilers, water heaters and thermostats, not for clothes dryers or cooktops. For those see our Peoples Gas and Nicor Gas pages. Naperville customers get electric rebates from the city, not ComEd, and the city lists a $75 thermostat rebate on its own page.
We did not confirm appliance rebates from Ameren Illinois, and we did not read ComEd's rules for apartments in multi-family buildings. Ask before you buy if you live in either.
claim_heading: How to claim an appliance rebate
claim_steps: Check the product is ENERGY STAR certified, or an induction model.
Buy it new before December 31, 2026 and keep the receipt.
Apply online or by mail within 60 days of the purchase.
Wait about four weeks after approval for a check.
Ask the store about instant coupons, which skip the form.
faq: How much is the ComEd heat pump dryer rebate?
$200 for an ENERGY STAR certified heat pump clothes dryer.
Buy by December 31, 2026 and apply within 60 days of purchase or by February 28, 2027, whichever is first.
Does an induction cooktop need ENERGY STAR?
No. ComEd says the ENERGY STAR rule excludes induction cooktops and ranges.
Can I use this outside ComEd's area?
No. The rebates are for ComEd customers. Other utilities have their own programs.
ComEd lists separate income-eligible rebates and free programs. Call 855-433-2700 to ask which apply to you.
